title: Fix item search failures when building a new order; custom line items on new orders
requested_outcome: When adding an item to a new order by name, the same words that already match in variant search must successfully add that item to the order card; right now an active, in-stock item repeatedly fails to add even though variant search finds it, leaving the order card empty. Also make it possible to add a custom line item (for example ten sticker packs that are no longer an active product) to a NEW order, with a title and a price at minimum. Nothing else about how orders are built, priced or shown should change. Adding a custom line item to an EXISTING order is not part of this build: it needs a new reviewed Shopify mutation and write tool on protected paths, which the Director builds separately (the owner approved it on 1 October).
acceptance_criteria: An active, in-stock product that matches in variant search by name can be added as a line item to a new order without the add failing or the order card staying empty.
A custom line item (a title and a price, with no matching product) can be added to a new order.
Adding a custom or inactive-product line item to a new order does not require or invent a variant_id.
Nothing about existing orders, pricing or how the order card is shown changes.
The change is proven by tests in crooks-assistant/tests/test_fix_item_search_failures_order_creation.py, and they pass.
